note: Town of Mattawamkeag-owned park (1,000 acres) on the Mattawamkeag River, run by Mattawamkeag Wilderness Recreation Services in 2026. 6 full-hookup (R1-R6) and 8 W/E RV sites. Reached by a 7.6-mi maintained gravel/dirt access road off US-2 — operator says drive-in, reachable for most vehicles (long but not 4WD); aggregators overstate it as 'off-highway.' --Claude
